name: Aero Med Industries
old_description: Thank you for taking time to visit us. Aero-Med Industries Inc. is a company located in Cleveland, OH. We are a leading company in Machine Shops, aerospace and prototype, with many years of experience.
about:
Aero-Med Industries Inc. operates from Cleveland, Ohio, where it has built a reputation in machine shops, aerospace, and prototype work. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but describes itself as having many years of experience in the region and as a recognized leader on the local market.

The shop provides precision machining, production and prototype runs, and commercial services. No details on facility size, headcount, annual volumes, or part numbers are published. The company presents itself as a full-service machine shop capable of handling both prototype and production quantities.

Its stated focus includes aerospace and prototype manufacturing, serving customers who need machined components for those sectors. The company does not name specific clients or industry verticals beyond aerospace and prototype work, though its "commercial services" suggests a broader industrial customer base.

Aero-Med emphasizes a complete client experience from start to finish, citing its employees as the driving force behind its reputation. The company says it invests in personal and professional development for its staff, believing that inspired employees deliver higher quality. When Cleveland thinks about quality and customer care, the firm claims, they think of Aero-Med.
